chunks.arabic_text: وَ رَوَى ٱبْنُ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ رِئَابٍ عَنْ حُمْرَانَ بْنِ أَعْيَنَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ عَلَيْهِ ٱلسَّلَامُ:

translations.en: Ibn Mahbub narrated from ʿAli ibn Riʾab, from Humran ibn Aʿyan, from Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام:

chunks.arabic_text: فِي رَجُلٍ كَانَ عَلَيْهِ طَوَافُ ٱلنِّسَاءِ وَحْدَهُ فَطَافَ مِنْهُ خَمْسَةَ أَشْوَاطٍ بِٱلْبَيْتِ ثُمَّ غَمَزَهُ بَطْنُهُ فَخَافَ أَنْ يَبْدُرَهُ فَخَرَجَ إِلَى مَنْزِلِهِ فَنَفَضَ ثُمَّ غَشِيَ جَارِيَتَهُ

translations.en: Regarding a man upon whom only Tawaf al-Nisa remained: he performed five circuits of the House, then his stomach troubled him, and he feared it would overcome him, so he went out to his residence, relieved himself, and then had intercourse with his slave-girl.

chunks.arabic_text: قَالَ «يَغْتَسِلُ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ فَيَطُوفُ بِٱلْبَيْتِ تَمَامَ مَا بَقِيَ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ طَوَافِهِ وَ يَسْتَغْفِرُ رَبَّهُ وَ لَا يَعُودُ».

translations.en: He عليه السلام said: "He should perform ghusl, then return and circumambulate the House, completing what remained upon him of his tawaf, and seek forgiveness from his Lord, and not repeat it."

en.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person who interrupted Tawaf al-Nisa after completing five circuits and then had intercourse before finishing it. Imam Abu Jaʿfar عليه السلام instructs him to perform ghusl, return to complete the remaining circuits, seek forgiveness, and not repeat the act.
en.seo_question: What should someone do if he has intercourse before completing Tawaf al-Nisa?

key_terms.طَوَافُ ٱلنِّسَاءِ: The tawaf required after hajj rites to permit marital relations.
key_terms.أَشْوَاطٍ: The circuits or rounds performed around the Kaʿbah.
key_terms.جَارِيَتَهُ: His slave-girl with whom he had intercourse.
